value.rationale: Full sharp stepsize classification of the natural simplest periodic incremental strongly convex problem; a disconnected stability set, isolated instability at equality, and exact curvature-versus-momentum critical ratio quantify a counterintuitive learning-rate restoration. This separates epoch convergence from one-step monotonicity and gives a concrete caution for cyclic momentum tuning without claiming higher-dimensional generality. The two explicit component-cancellation stepsizes additionally minimize the per-cycle spectral radius at beta irrespective of curvature contrast, clarifying how the high-step stable island arises.
